440: func (r *AccountReconciler) handleAccountInitializingRegions(reqLogger logr.Logger, currentAcctInstance *awsv1alpha1.Account) (reconcile.Result, error) {
441: 	irCond := currentAcctInstance.GetCondition(awsv1alpha1.AccountInitializingRegions)
442: 	if irCond == nil {
443: 		// This should never happen: the thing that made IsInitializingRegions true
444: 		// also added the Condition.
445: 		errMsg := "Unexpectedly couldn't find the InitializingRegions Condition"
446: 		_, stateErr := r.setAccountFailed(
447: 			reqLogger,
448: 			currentAcctInstance,
449: 			awsv1alpha1.AccountInternalError,
450: 			"MissingCondition",
451: 			errMsg,
452: 			AccountFailed,
453: 		)
454: 		return reconcile.Result{}, stateErr
455: 	}
456: 	// Detect whether we set the InitializingRegions condition in *this* invocation of the
457: 	// operator or a previous one.
458: 	if irCond.LastTransitionTime.Before(utils.GetOperatorStartTime()) {
459: 		// This means the region init goroutine(s) for this account were still running when an
460: 		// earlier invocation of the operator died. We want to recover those, so set them back
461: 		// to Creating, which should cause us to hit the region init code path again.
462: 		// TODO(efried): There's still a small hole here: If the controller was dead for
463: 		// too long, this can still land us in `accountCreatingTooLong` and fail the Account.
464: 		// At the time of this writing, that specifically applies to a) non-CCS accounts, and
465: 		// b) more than 25 minutes between initial Account creation and the Reconcile after
466: 		// this one.
467: 		msg := "Recovering from stale region initialization."
468: 		// We're no longer InitializingRegions
469: 		utils.SetAccountCondition(
470: 			currentAcctInstance.Status.Conditions,
471: 			awsv1alpha1.AccountInitializingRegions,
472: 			// Switch the Condition off
473: 			corev1.ConditionFalse,
474: 			AccountInitializingRegions,
475: 			msg,
476: 			// Make sure the existing condition is updated
477: 			utils.UpdateConditionAlways,
478: 			currentAcctInstance.Spec.BYOC)
479: 		// TODO(efried): This doesn't change the lastTransitionTime, which it really should.
480: 		// In fact, since the Creating condition is guaranteed to already be present, this
481: 		// is currently not doing anything more than
482: 		//    currentAcctInstance.Status.State = AccountCreating
483: 		utils.SetAccountStatus(currentAcctInstance, msg, awsv1alpha1.AccountCreating, AccountCreating)
484: 		// The status update will trigger another Reconcile, but be explicit. The requests get
485: 		// collapsed anyway.
486: 		return reconcile.Result{Requeue: true}, r.statusUpdate(currentAcctInstance)
487: 	}
488: 	// The goroutines happened in this invocation. Time out if that has taken too long.
489: 	if time.Since(irCond.LastTransitionTime.Time) > regionInitTime {
490: 		errMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Initializing regions for longer than %d seconds", regionInitTime/time.Second)
491: 		_, stateErr := r.setAccountFailed(
492: 			reqLogger,
493: 			currentAcctInstance,
494: 			awsv1alpha1.AccountCreationFailed,
495: 			"RegionInitializationTimeout",
496: 			errMsg,
497: 			AccountFailed,
498: 		)
499: 		return reconcile.Result{}, stateErr
500: 	}
